passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Sheriff Davis said an investigator remains assigned to the Short case and works on it nearly every day. Virginia State Police and FBI investigators continue assisting.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: A reward of more than $60,000 remains offered for information leading to the arrest and conviction of whoever killed Michael, Mary and Jennifer Short.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The murders remain unsolved.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Virginia State Police continues listing the Short family investigation as an active homicide case.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The investigative focus is now broader than Bowman and includes a complete reassessment of the case file and modern forensic testing of evidence preserved since 2002.

passages.section: Crime Scene and Forensic Evidence
passages.subsection: Evidence Removed From the Short Family Home:
passages.text: Investigators conducted an extensive search of the Short family residence at 10680 Virginia Avenue in Henry County, Virginia, following the discovery of Michael and Mary Short on August 15, 2002. Dozens of items were removed from the residence for examination as investigators worked to reconstruct the murders and determine what happened to 9-year-old Jennifer Short.

passages.section: Crime Scene and Forensic Evidence
passages.text: Investigators recovered two.22-caliber cartridge casings from separate areas of the residence. Investigators recovered one casing from Mary Short’s bed and the second from the garage floor near Michael Short.

passages.section: Crime Scene and Forensic Evidence
passages.text: Gunshot residue testing was performed on both Michael and Mary Short.

passages.section: Crime Scene and Forensic Evidence
passages.text: Investigators collected bedding associated with both victims, including bed covers and a bed sheet from Mary’s bed, several of Mary’s pillows, and blankets located beneath Michael in the garage.
